text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Omnibus IV – Digitalisation and common specifications (Directive) – COM(2025) 503 (proposal)

Procedure 2025/0133(COD). Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); steps done (blue) and in progress (orange) as of 04 Oct 2026. Lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see product-digitalisation-directive.html).
Coreper confirms final compromise text, 24 Jun 2026
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading.
